selector.rationale: The presence of a hard, mobile, well-delineated, and yellowish-white lesion protruding through the right palatine tonsil, along with a uniform ovoid calcification overlying the right tonsillar region, supports the diagnosis of Tonsillolith.

rejected.label: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
rejected.why: The absence of mucosal ulceration, mass, or cervical lymphadenopathy, and the presence of a well-delineated and non-tender lesion, contradict the diagnosis of Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
